run_extract_texture_sizes: run the script to extract 2D image sizes from a scene file and save them to a binary output
run_importer_manager_load: run the AnySceneImporter via ImporterManager to load and instantiate a scene file for image extraction
run_image2d_iteration: run iteration over all 2D images in an imported scene to collect their dimensions
run_binary_array_write: run writing of extracted image size data to a binary file using array.array with short integers
run_size_filtering: run filtering of image sizes by max dimension and ratio to exclude oversized images from the output
